_about: The standard exit table: 8 stops x 4 targets = 32 exit cells, the same for every idea (engine/l2sim.py MENU_*, menu(root); run_menus runs every cell with hold = day). Cells in menu order: stops outer (`stop_order`, then the listed values), targets inner. A stop is ATR x (Wilder ATR14 on the idea's bar size), fixed points per market, or percent of the entry price; a target is reward:risk from the stop distance, 0 = no target (the trade runs to its stop or to the flat time). Nobody adds or changes a cell after seeing a result. Locked to the engine by tests/test_blueprint_rules.py.
text: Variants = the standard exit table (8 stops × 4 targets) × the 3-4 values of the idea's main setting.
